scope: baseline-only conservative damping-increment allowance, fixed elastic output and common modal damping change
not_claimed: goal improvement achieved merely because error bound passes

baseline_once_per_floor_record.uncertainty: known fixed numerical-error allowance and baseline force uncertainty; sampled maxima need appropriate numerical-bound status

bound.no_target_truth: Only baseline derivative scales and known target damping parameter enter.

project_budgets.improvement_width: Wmax*P0/2, sufficient even when lower peak interval clips at0
project_budgets.no_requirement: Do not invent a radius without a specified error budget.
project_budgets.target_peak_relative_tolerance: Separate rule below; eps0*P0 is not this denominator.

positive_radius.monotonicity: proved for d>0 with zeta0>0,Jp>0; allows safe bisection
positive_radius.return: largest certified passing lower endpoint within predefined domain, plus bracket and slack
positive_radius.if_cap_passes: All increments through cap pass this bound; not a claim beyond cap.

negative_radius.near_zero_target: Infinite-window kernel norm diverges as target damping tends0; this conservative failure does not assert finite-window response divergence.

monotonicity_proof.negative: x^n and kappa(zeta0-x) are both increasing
monotonicity_proof.extension: kappa=1 at/above critical damping; continuous at1

bisection.initial: lo=0; hi=cap; test cap first; require physical domain
bisection.floating: Keep pass margin and numerical precision status; overflow/NaN is not passing.
bisection.varying_numerical_error: Need common upper envelope or independent monotonicity proof; otherwise do not assume bisection monotonic.

relative_to_unknown_target_peak.candidate_specific: If Phat>E_total, require E_total/(Phat-E_total)<=eps_star; this uses baseline polynomial Phat, not truth.
relative_to_unknown_target_peak.not_known_monotone: Do not infer a full allowed interval from one candidate-specific passing point.
relative_to_unknown_target_peak.denominator_zero: Target-relative error undefined, use absolute-force requirement.

near_zero_baseline.trigger: P0=0 or P0 not resolved above baseline force-error bound/project relevance floor
near_zero_baseline.action: use absolute force budget; no improvement percentage or baseline-relative radius
near_zero_baseline.J_reported_zero: check precision before treating it as exact0; never automatically grant unlimited domain

selection: Use T1 if its budget passes; otherwise T2 if its budget passes; neither pass=>direct numerical extrapolation not approved under this bound. T2 need not have a larger allowed radius.

separate_statuses.decision_status: meets/insufficient/overlap of goal interval; adverse flag separately
separate_statuses.action: preserve mathematical goal conclusions even when precision gate fails; follow frozen project recomputation policy

joint_radius: minimum across predeclared key floors and input records; not all possible earthquakes
